title: Close the rest of git's maintenance race: other harness origins, retries, herdr
description:
mel closed the race for everything ticfac starts. Remaining, found and deliberately left:

1. Maintenance OTHERS start still races: the operator's own commit/fetch mid-run, a scheduled 'git maintenance start', an agent passing its own -c. A further layer: a bounded retry of the IDEMPOTENT plumbing writes (tracker staged/treeOn, the store's private-index commits) on exactly 'unable to create temporary file'. NOT integrate.go, where a failed merge is a merge failure, not a retry.
2. Other test harnesses' bare origins have the origin-side twin (receive-pack's repack racing a concurrent push: 'unable to migrate objects to permanent storage'): internal/runstate/origin_test.go (heavy concurrent CAS pushes — most exposed), internal/exec/subprocess/harness_test.go, internal/exec/herdr/harness_test.go, internal/cli/cloud_test.go, internal/cli/findings_test.go. Each is one 'git config maintenance.auto false' on the origin.
3. A real run whose origin is a LOCAL-PATH bare repository has the same origin-side race. Does not apply against a forge.
4. The herdr executor's runner environment does not get the maintenance setting; how herdr launches agents was not traced.

Per the standing rule, (2) is not a flake-proofing chore: each of those is a race waiting to fail a gate on a git 2.55 runner.
acceptance_criteria: No test origin and no ticfac-launched environment can start git maintenance concurrently with a run's writes, and idempotent plumbing writes survive a single ENOENT from a concurrent repack
